reason: I'm not going to a separate shop website for fabric. I search Allegro, sort by price with delivery, and buy from whoever comes out cheapest with Smart. If TextilWorld happens to be on top that week I'll buy from them, but I wouldn't be choosing them, the sort order would.
objection: Nothing here tells me why I'd pick them over the other sellers on Allegro. 14.90 for black viscose is fine but not special, and I can't see if they do Smart delivery or what shipping costs. A 0.5 m cut is useless to me if delivery costs more than the fabric.
would_change_my_mind: Being clearly the cheapest on Allegro with delivery included, i.e. Smart on their listings, or free locker delivery on their own site that beats the Allegro total.
